text:
maya: Quick sync — Q3 catalog onramp. We need a compact acceptance slab + migration boundaries for enterprise pins. Can we decide defaults and escalation paths in this thread?

liam: What do you mean by 'acceptance slab'?

maya: Minimal benchmarks + rollout & deprecation SLAs. Eg latency targets, embedding recall, cost delta, and canary thresholds.

alex: +1. Also need to nail pin behavior: default TTL, enterprise exceptions, and automated fallback logic.

tanya: Heads-up from sales: some customers require pin permanence or long transition windows, otherwise they threaten to delay cutover.

jordan: Proposal draft: default pin TTL = 30d, enterprise opt-in TTL = 180d (signed), migration notice = 90d, canary cohort = 5% for 48h.

liam: Implementation question — can we enforce TTL at routing? yes, policy tags + route rules. Ops impact is medium.

maya: Rough acceptance criteria I want in spec (will formalize):
```yaml
acceptance:
  latency_p95: "<=300ms"
  embedding_recall_k10: ">=0.85"
  cost_delta: "<=15% vs baseline"
  rollout_canary: "5% traffic for 48h"
```

alex: Add to deprecation policy: automatic fallback if regen error rate > 2% over 5m, and immediate rollback button in console.

tanya: Also require comms playbook: account rep outreach + migration credits for enterprise customers. Sales needs that spelled out in contract language.

jordan: Telemetry needs: per-tenant eval set + drift alerts + daily canary summary. That determines whether we proceed to open rollout.

liam: Ops asks: attach a pre-flight job that runs the model on a sample tenant corpus and fails the onboarding if any metric regresses beyond thresholds. We can use existing eval infra.

maya: Decision point: choose default pin TTL (14d vs 30d). Quick thumbs.

alex: +1 30d — more runway for rollback.

tanya: Sales push: want 180d opt-in for large customers.

jordan: Compromise: default 30d; enterprise opt-in 180d with explicit migration SLA + paid migration support.

maya: Agreed. I'll update the roadmap ticket and produce an initial spec doc: onboarding acceptance slab + migration playbook + comms template.

liam: I'll own the canary/runbook: thresholds, rollback script, contact list. Will add to eng-releases board.

canary-bot: canary deploy started: model:v3 -> health OK (t=1749999250) :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — I'll share the draft by EOD and loop in legal for contract language for the enterprise opt-in.

alex: One more small ask: include a short matrix for 'compat-shim' vs 'hard-swap' so product and sales can present migration options.

maya: Will add. End of thread.
